row.scim_addon_price_text: SSO/SCIM add-on on Business: price not published (contact support)
row.evidence: Shortcut's pricing table lists SCIM as "Add-on" on Business and "Included" on Enterprise, and the SCIM help page says "SCIM relies on SSO/SAML, which is included on Enterprise plans and available as an add-on on Business plans".
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated) but the gate changed since June: June said Business ($12/u/mo) includes SSO and SCIM; the pricing table now shows SSO and SCIM as an Add-on on Business and Included on Enterprise, and the SCIM help page confirms it. The add-on price is not published, so scim_price_per_user_mo and the multiplier are null (June: $12, 1.4x). Team $8.50 and Business $12 per user/month annual are unchanged ($10/$16 monthly). SCIM is officially Okta-only (Shortcut SCIM OIN app, create/update/deactivate), workspace-level, needs SAML and an invitation-only workspace, and the Workspace ID and token come from support. The REST API (v3 and v4) is on every plan including Free; v4 can change a member's role or disabled status and manage team membership, but cannot create or invite users.

operations.notes: Docs list Push New Users, Push Profile Updates and Push User Deactivation only; the Okta OIN page checks Create, Update, Deactivate and not Group Push.

custom.how: role attribute (Admin, Member, Observer) is required; listed under the core User schema namespace

attributes.notes: userName and email are both the user's email address; unique identifier is email.

roles.how: role attribute: Admin, Member or Observer (Owner not supported)

limitations.text: Only Okta is officially supported for SCIM.
SCIM is per Workspace; multi-Workspace organisations need a separate SCIM app for each Workspace.
Requires SAML SSO and an invitation-only workspace; credentials are issued by support.
Owner role cannot be set via SCIM.

capabilities.notes: Update Member sets role and disabled; Teams (v4) and Groups (v3) take member_ids. No create, invite or delete member endpoint is listed.

endpoints.purpose: Update Member role or disabled status

rate_limits.text: 200 requests per minute; over-limit requests get 429.

limitations.text: v3 tokens do not work with v4 endpoints.

okta.notes: Two OIN apps: 'Shortcut' (SAML) and 'Shortcut SCIM' (provisioning: Create, Update, Deactivate).

entra.notes: Shortcut lists Microsoft Entra ID as a supported SAML IdP; no Entra gallery tutorial found (shortcut-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Google Workspace listed as a supported SAML IdP.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin listed as a supported SAML IdP.

fallbacks.other_sync: Auto-join by email domain; admin invites

conflicts.text: The SAML help page says SSO is an add-on for paid plans (which would include Team), while the pricing table and SCIM help page show SSO/SCIM as an add-on on Business only and not available on Team. Pricing page used.

open_questions: Price of the Business SSO/SCIM add-on is not published.
Whether SCIM-deactivated users have sessions revoked is not documented.
SCIM endpoints beyond user provisioning (Groups, ServiceProviderConfig, PUT vs PATCH, filtering, pagination) are not documented.
Whether a non-Okta SCIM client can use the documented base URI and token is not stated (only Okta is officially supported).
No audit-log API and no user-event webhooks are documented; outgoing webhooks cover story activity.
Entra gallery, Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue listings not confirmed.
